adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` is byte-for-byte identical in effect to `#show`: it just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` and never reads `params` or persists anything. The route `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` is added, and the Ember controller includes `saveChanges() { this.get('embedding').update({}); }`, so an update pathway is wired up but currently a no-op. However, the current admin UI template (`embedding.hbs`) doesn’t expose a save button and the `saveChanges` action submits `{}` (no changes), so this is more an incomplete/placeholder implementation than a demonstrable broken behavior in this PR.
